hypotheses.reasoning: A template-svc instance restart (capacity 3/4) was a survivable trigger. notification-svc then retried renders immediately with backoff disabled (up to 4 attempts), which drove template-svc inbound traffic to 3-4x baseline. template-svc kept shedding load with 503, so the gateway kept returning 503s and the incident did not recover.

verdict.recommendedAction: Re-enable exponential backoff with jitter on notification-svc TemplateClient, or add a retry budget. Scale template-svc back to full capacity. Shed or throttle /v1/notify until template-svc recovers.
